newsitem.title: CHINA: Cathay sees better second half results.
newsitem.headline: Cathay sees better second half results.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its results for the second half of 1997 to show an improvement over its first-half results, but it said operating conditions would remain difficult.
The Hong Kong flag carrier reported a 35 percent decline in interim net profit for the first six months of the year to HK$1.07 billion.

"As in previous years we expect the results for the second half year to show an improvement over those for the first half, although operating conditions are clearly going to stay difficult with yields continuing to be under pressure and some markets remaining very soft," Cathay Pacific said in a statement.
